title.narrative: Supporting Palestine in the effective implementation of the 1954 Convention at the national level

description.narrative: This activity supports the State of Palestine in implementing the 1954 Hague Convention for the Protection of Cultural Property in the Event of Armed Conflict by safeguarding cultural heritage in Gaza during the ongoing conflict. It will sustain and update the assessment of damage to cultural property, complemented by rapid on-site verification where access and security permit; support emergency stabilization and protective measures for the most at-risk sites and the documentation and securing of movable cultural property against loss and illicit trafficking, in coordination with the Palestinian Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities. Applying a conflict-sensitive, do-no-harm approach throughout, the activity reduces further loss, stabilizes endangered cultural property, and reinforces national emergency-preparedness, thereby operationalizing Palestine's commitments under the 1954 Convention.
